name: Temple Gold
description: Ivory page with maroon bands, a gold gopuram arch, kolam knots and carved temple doors that swing open.

name: Mango Leaf & Marigold
description: Festive thoranam garlands of mango leaves and marigolds, and a rice-flour kolam that draws itself.

name: Kanjivaram Silk
description: Peacock teal and magenta silk with woven gold zari borders, temple-border bands and paisley motifs.

name: Kerala Kasavu
description: Airy ivory and kasavu gold stripes, a nilavilakku lamp and jasmine strings. Calm and refined.

name: Blush Botanical
description: Soft watercolor blush and sage, line-art roses, script names and a wax-sealed envelope intro.

name: Midnight Art Deco
description: Navy and gold Gatsby glamour with sunburst gates, stepped frames and deco countdown tiles.

name: Modern Editorial
description: Fashion-magazine minimalism: oversized serif type, an asymmetric grid and one terracotta accent.

name: Henna Mandala
description: Mehendi line-work in henna and saffron around a slowly turning mandala that blooms open.

name: Celestial Night
description: Twinkling indigo sky, a crescent moon, a constellation of the couple's initials and a moon-phase countdown.

name: Vintage Postcard
description: Airmail stripes, a perforated stamp, postmarks, ticket-style events and handwritten wish notes.

name: Thoranam Housewarming
description: Mango-leaf and marigold thoranam over the door and a kolam at the threshold, for a Gruhapravesam.

name: Twinkle Little Star
description: A soft night sky, a crescent moon and the birthday star's initial in the stars.
